content: Kabena kida aiamie
Jesos ki adisoke oo8e kidji kikinoama8adjin okikinoamaganan kabena kidji aiamiendjin, ega dac kidji ana8endjigendjin.
Ki inadisoke dac: “Teban pejig odenakag tibakonige8inni, ega e manadjiadjin Kije Manidon acitc ega a8ian e kidimagenimadjin.
Teban acitc iima odenakag e pejigodj ik8e e nta nda 8abamapanin ini tibakonige8innin e pagosenimadjin: ‘8idjiicin kidji cagodjiag ka k8ag8e madjiseijidj.’ ”
“Aa tibakonige8inni kin8ej ka8in ododji iji nda8endasin. Kegapitc dac ki inendam: ‘Teb8e ka8in nimanadjiasi Kije Manido acitc ka8in a8iag nikidimagenimasi.

Misa8adj dac nidaieko8ig aa ka pejigodj ik8e. Niga 8idjia dac kidji 8ik8adjitama8ag adi eji nda8endag. Kicpin mega ega iidi todaman, apanigotc niga pi nda 8abamig, pinici kidji nickiijidj,’ ki inendam.”
Kiabadj dac ka Tibendjigedj ki ikido: “Ndotaok aa madji tibakonige8inni adi ekidodj.
Kije Manido dac 8in, kana oga ndota8asin ini8e kagi onabamadjin, ini8e kabena ka pagosenimigodjin meg8a kijik acitc meg8a tibik? Kin8ej na oga piton kidji 8idjiadjin?
Ki8idamonom, teci8ag oga 8idjian, adi e iji nda8endamindjin. Misa8adj dac ii, apitc koki pijaian, nin, Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj, niga mika8ag na a8iagog ka teb8etamo8adj ooma akikag?”
Pakan ka iji aiamie8adj nijin nabeg
Jesos oo8e ki inadisoke, e aiamiadjin nandam a8iagon “nik8aiakozimin” ka inenimidizondjin, ka maskenimandjin kodagian a8iagon.

Ki ikido: “Nijin a8iagog ki pidige8agoban kitci aiamiemigi8amikag kidji nda aiamie8adj. Pejig aa8e Coda8inni ka nagadjitodjin inakonige8inan inabadizigoban, kodag dac aa8e ka ma8adjiadjin conian kitci ogiman odji inabadizigoban 8in.

Nigan iji tajigaba8igoban aa Coda8inni ka nagadjitodjin inakonige8inan, acitc mi ekidogobanen e aiamiedj: ‘Kije Manido! Mig8etc kidinin ega nin e inadizian tabickotc kodagiag a8iagog, ka kimodi8adj, ka madji inadizi8adj, acitc ka pamendamo8adj madji aido8ini. Mig8etc kidinin ega nin e inadizian tabickotc aa8e ka ma8adjiadjin conian kitci ogiman odji.
Nijokajik taso ta8ate nipagidadjige, acitc midatcin somanike tas8abik e kackiag kiminin.’ ”

“Aa dac ka ma8adjiadjin conian kitci ogiman odji, 8in odakanag iji tajigaba8igoban. Ka8in 8a8adj 8i icpanabisiban. Papakiteodizoban okakiganikag kidji 8abadai8edj e an8endizodj, acitc ki ikidoban: ‘Kije Manido! Kidimagenimicin, nin e kitci patado8inni8ian.’ ”

Jesos dac ki ikido: “Ki8idamonom, ki ki8e aa nabe e k8aiak8abamigodjin Kije Manidon, ka8in dac 8in aa8e ka nagadjitodjin inakonige8inan. A8enenigotc mega icpenimidizodj, kada tabasendagozi, anic dac a8enenigotc tabasenimidizodj, kada icpendagozi.”
Jesos odaiamit8anan abinodjijan

Nandam a8iagog ogi iji8ina8an 8a8adj abinodjijesan Jesosikag, kidji gi aiamit8anandjin e saminandjin. Kikinoamaganag dac ogi 8abama8an, acitc ogi kaganona8an ini a8iagon ka pidji8inandjin ini abinodjijesan.

Jesos dac ogi nd8e8eman abinodjijan, acitc ogi inan okikinoamaganan: “Pagidinikog abinodjijag kidji pi nazikaoji8adj! Ka8in odjiakegonig. A8iagog mega tabickotc abinodjijag ka apitendagozi8adj, Kije Manidon Odogima8i8inikag kada iji tibendagozi8ag.
Teb8e ki8idamonom, a8iag ega nda8endag Kije Manidon Odogima8i8ini, tabickotc abinodjij ke iji nda8endagiban, ka8in 8ikad oga kackitosin kidji pidigedj Kije Manidon Odogima8i8inikag.”
Nabe ka kitci oconiamidj
Pejig Coda8inni ka niganizidj ogi k8ag8edjiman Jesosan: “Kikinoamage8inni, kin ka kije8adizian! Adi ke todamaban kidji odisigo8an kagige pimadizi8in?”
Jesos ogi inan: “8egonen 8edji inijian e kije8adizian? Kije Manido eta kije8adizi.
Kikikendanan Kije Manido odinakonige8inan:

content.text: Ka8in anodjigotc kiga iji inactaonasi8a8a kidjipimadizimi8a.

content: Mi ekidomaganigin Kije Manido odinakonige8inan.”
Aa nabe ki ikido: “Kakina nigi nosoneanan ini inakonige8inan ka ako abinodjiji8ian.”

Apitc Jesos ka nodag ii, ogi inan: “Kiabadj pejig kegon kinodese. Ada8en kakina kidaiman, acitc ca8enimik ka kidimagizi8adj kiconiaman, midac kidji aiamanin 8anadizi8inan 8ak8ig. Pijan dac acitc nosoneocin.”
Apitc dac aa nabe ka nodag ii, ki kitci kackendamise. Kitci 8anadizigoban mega.
Jesos ogi 8abaman e kackendamisendjin, acitc ki ikido: “8esa kitci sanagizi8ag ka 8anadizi8adj kidji gi pidige8adj Kije Manidon Odogima8i8inikag!

Kitci sanagizi ka nijo pik8aoganedj a8esiz kidji gi cabocta8eckapan cabonigani ka iji pagoneanig, anic dac na8adj kiabadj sanagizi a8iag ka 8anadizidj kidji gi pidigedj Kije Manidon Odogima8i8inikag.”
Ini8e ka nodamindjin adi ka ikidodj ogi igon: “A8enen dac kegi ag8acimagani8idj?”
Jesos dac ki ikido: “Kegoni a8iag ka p8ana8itodj, Kije Manido 8in okackiton.”
Pien dac ki ikido: “Nina8it, kakina kegon ka aiamagiban nigi nagadananan kidji nosoneogo8an.”
Jesos dac ogi inan: “Teb8e ki8idamonom, kicpin a8iag nagadag omigi8am, kek8an naganadjin okokomiman, o8idjiki8en, onigiigon, kek8an odabinodjijiman, Kije Manidon Odogima8i8ini odji,
kiabadj a8acamej oga odisigon ooma ka iji pimadiziak nogom, nage dac acitc oga aian kagige pimadizi8ini.”
Aja nisinanaj Jesos tibadjimo kidji nibodj acitc kidji abidjibadj

Jesos ogi madji8inan okikinoamaganan acitc ogi inan: “Ndotamok! Jerusalem kiga ijamin, teb8e kakina kidji ijiseg kagi ijibiige8adj niganadjimo8innig e mikomiji8adj, nin, Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj, kidji iji8ebizian.
Niga iji8inigo ega ka Coda8inni8i8adj kidji tibenimiji8adj. Igi8e dac niga manenimigog, niga mamanazomigog, acitc niga sasik8anigog.
Niga papajacteogog, acitc niga nisigog. Ki nisogonaganig dac, niga abidjiba8an.”
Ka8in dac odji pejig ododji nisidotasina8a adi 8a ikidondjin Jesosan. Ki kadama8agani8i8ag mega adi maia 8a ikidomaganig, ka8in dac ododji kikendasina8a adi 8a ikidondjin.
Jesos okigean pejig naben ega e 8abindjin
Jesos acitc okikinoamaganan ogi ani pec8abadana8agoban Jeriko (Jéricho) odenani. Pejig nabe ega e 8abidj taji abigoban opimekana, e pagosenimodj conian.
Apitc dac aa nabe ka nodag mane a8iagon e pimosendjin, ki k8ag8ed8e adi eji8ebanig.
Ki inagani8i dac: “Jesos, Nazaret ka odjidj, pimi ija ooma.”
Ki madji pabibagi dac: “Jesos! Ogima David odanike ojisan! Kidimagenimicin!”
Igi8e dac ka nigani8adj ogi kaganona8abanin, acitc ogi ina8an kidji ponimondjin. Na8adj dac kiabadj ki kiji8egoban e pabibagidj: “Ogima David odanike ojisan! Kidimagenimicin!”
Jesos dac ki kibitcigaba8i, acitc ki ikido: “Pidji8ijik aa.” Apitc dac ka pec8abamigodjin, Jesos ogi k8ag8edjiman:
“8egonen eji nda8endaman kidji todaonan?” Aa nabe ki ikido: “Tebendjigean! Kipagosenimin kidji kigeijian kidji gi koki 8abian.”
Jesos dac ogi inan: “Mi iji 8abin. Kiteb8etamo8in kigi kigeigon.”
Teci8ag dac ogi kackitonagoban kidji 8abidj, acitc ogi nosone8an Jesosan, e icpenimadjin Kije Manidon. Apitc dac kakina a8iagog ka 8abadamo8adj adi eji8ebanig, ke8ina8a ogi icpenima8an Kije Manidon.
